tools.description: Creates MDK projects or entity metadata using templates (CRUD, List Detail, Base). Use this for initializing new projects or adding entity metadata to existing projects.

folderRootPath.description: The path of the current project root folder.

oDataEntitySets.description: The OData entity sets relevant to the user prompt, separated by commas.

offline.description: Whether to generate the project in offline mode (only applicable for project scope). Set to false unless offline is explicitly specified.

scope.description:
The scope of creation:
• project: Initialize a new MDK project with full structure
• entity: Add entity metadata to an existing project

templateType.description: The type of template to use. Note: 'base' template is only valid for project scope.

tools.name: mdk-create

tools.description: Unified tool for accessing MDK documentation including search, component schemas, property details, and examples.

N.description: Number of results to return for search operation.

component_name.description: Name of the component (required for 'component', 'property', and 'example' operations).

folderRootPath.description: The path of the current project root folder. Used to determine the appropriate MDK schema version.

operation.description:
The type of documentation operation to perform:
• search: Returns the top N results from MDK documentation by semantic search, sorted by relevance
• component: Returns the schema of an MDK component based on the name of the component
• property: Returns the documentation of a specific property of an MDK component
• example: Returns an example usage of an MDK component

property_name.description: Name of the property (required for 'property' operation).

tools.name: mdk-docs

tools.description: Generates MDK artifacts including pages, actions, i18n files, and rule references. Returns prompts for LLM processing (pages, actions, i18n) or searches for rule examples.

actionType.description: The type of action (required when artifactType is 'action').

artifactType.description:
The type of artifact to generate:
• page: Generate MDK page files (.page) with databinding or layout
• action: Generate MDK action files (.action)
• i18n: Generate internationalization files (.properties)
• rule: Search for and return relevant JavaScript rule examples

controlType.description: The control type for databinding pages (required when pageType is 'databinding').

folderRootPath.description: The path of the current project root folder (not required for rule artifact type).

layoutType.description: The layout type for layout pages (required when pageType is 'layout').

oDataEntitySets.description: Optional: The OData entity sets to use for page/action generation, separated by commas (required only when artifactType is 'action' or artifactType is 'page' and pageType is 'databinding').

pageType.description:
The type of page (required when artifactType is 'page'):
• databinding: Data-driven pages with controls bound to OData
• layout: Structure-focused pages with specific layouts

query.description: Search query for rule reference (required only when artifactType is 'rule'). Examples: 'get app name', 'handle form validation', 'navigate to page', etc.

tools.name: mdk-gen

tools.description: Comprehensive MDK project management tool that handles build, deploy, validate, migrate, show QR code, and mobile app editor operations.

externals.description: Optional: Array of external package names to include in the deployment (e.g., ['@nativescript/geolocation']). Defaults to empty array if not specified.

folderRootPath.description: The path of the current project root folder.

operation.description:
The operation to perform on the MDK project. Available operations:
• build: Build an MDK project
• deploy: Deploy an MDK project to the Mobile Services
• validate: Validate an MDK project
• migrate: Migrate an MDK project to the latest MDK version
• show-qrcode: Show QR code for an MDK project
• open-mobile-app-editor: Instruct how to open the Mobile App Editor to create .service.metadata file

tools.name: mdk-manage
